QuestInfo.name: A Guide to Portal Operation
QuestInfo.0: With the seal taken care of, all that's left is reactivating the Interdimensional Portal. Ask #p3000003# about what is needed.
QuestInfo.1: #p3000003# says he needs plenty of magic stones for reactivation. #bDefeat #o2400014# at #m400010400# to obtain 50 #t4033345# and deliver them to him.#k
QuestInfo.2: Everything is ready! Are you prepared to travel to a new world?

0.0: Oh, come on. We're so close! Help me out.

yes.0: Now, to reactivate the Interdimensional Portal, we need lots of Magic Stones. However, we used up all of our Magic Stones during the last battle to create the Magic Amplifier. Defeat #o2400014# at #m400010400# and bring back 50 #t4033345# items.

no.0: If you're busy, finish up and come back. I want to get this done!

1.0: I think this is enough to make the catalyst. Thank you.

yes.0: That should be all I need from you. Prepare for your trip while I make ready to open the portal.

item.0: Where are the stones? Defeat #o2400014# at #m400010400# and bring back 50 #t4033345# items.
